q: 12 – 15 years of experience in the construction industry.
Sound techno-commercial, project management, design and contractual knowledge; proficiency in AutoCAD and design software.
Strong leadership, conflict management and assertive communication skills.

Plan and mobilize all required resources for execution (manpower, machinery, equipment and materials) on time, ensuring maximum utilization.
li
Ensure approvals for design, quality plan, construction methods, safety plan, IMS and other procedures are obtained from consultants and clients.
li
Monitor and ensure timely completion of the project in line with quality and safety norms, keeping project cost within the approved control estimate.
li
Coordinate with all support departments (QA/QC, design, survey, accounts and administration) at site level to ensure well-coordinated execution.

li

li
Drive the safety performance and accountability of subordinates and subcontractors, and represent the Project Manager in their absence.
